summary: Clearwater County, ID 74-foot L-6 lookout built 1933 under CTPA, abandoned 1957. A 1936 log cabin is reported in ruins (undated); no source says whether the tower still stands.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1957; firelookout.com says the 1936 log cabin is still there, in ruins. No source describes the tower's current state

events.note: Log cabin on the site; firelookout.com says it is still there, in ruins
Repairs made to the tower, per a combined annual report for 1953-54 that Forest Lookouts cites

evidence.supports: 1936 log cabin, still there in ruins per firelookout.com

notes_for_editor: Forest Lookouts cites 'Potatch TPA combined Annual Report 1953-54'; Potatch is probably Potlatch but is unverified, so the story does not name it. The firelookout.com cabin observation is undated. The University of Idaho Keeping Watch record gives coordinates and a link only, so it is not cited. No Forest Service records or photos found.
